主要内容: On March 11, 2021, Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. appointed Prathyusha Duraibabu as its principal financial officer, effective immediately. Duraibabu has served as the Company’s principal accounting officer since June 2019 and as Vice President, Finance since March 2019. She has over 22 years of experience in financial operations, organizational change, and team building. Prior to joining Sangamo, she worked as Corporate Controller at Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. from June 2010 to March 2019, where she managed global financial operations, strategy, audit, and tax. Duraibabu holds a Bachelors of Accounting from Oxford Brookes University and an M.B.A. from San Jose State University, and is a Certified Public Accountant in California. No new compensatory arrangements or modifications were made in connection with her appointment.
